articles.title: Binance users in some European countries told to pull crypto before fees kick in, with accounts closing by year end
articles.summary: Affected accounts are reportedly set to close on Dec. 31. Users in Spain, France, and Poland say they've received similar notices.

articles.title: Apple Completes the Set: Every Magnificent Seven Stock Opts Out of OKX-ICE Venue
articles.summary: Apple and Meta’s objections mean all seven of the biggest U.S. tech companies have now asked to keep their shares off the planned OKX-ICE venue.

articles.title: The Bantu expansion changed Africa. Scientists are still tracing how.
articles.summary: Genes and archaeology are revealing how Bantu speakers spread across much of Africa.
